name: force-field
description: Force-Field Protocol from Spin State Labs, one package: the FORCE runtime prompt protocol (/force), the FIELD governance framework (/field) with its Enforcement Gate hook (kill switch, protected paths, irreversible-action deny patterns, tool-call budget, hash-chained ledger), and a skill explaining how they compose. Replaces the separate force, field and force-field 1.x plugins.

estate_mode.title: FIELD mode
estate_mode.description: local: FIELD runs on this machine only (Enforcement Gate hook and local ledger); no network calls. estate: connect to an existing estate created by the FIELD platform through its MCP server.

estate_url.title: Estate MCP server URL
estate_url.description: Estate mode only. The MCP server (Streamable HTTP) endpoint of your estate, e.g. https://estate.example.com/mcp. https required except for localhost.

field_api_key.title: FIELD API key
field_api_key.description: Estate mode only. The API key the FIELD platform issued for your estate. Sent only to the estate URL as a Bearer token; stored as a secret.
